card.name: Dose caps after per-kilogram doses
card.fires_on: The opening parenthesis (or comma) right after a weight-based dose such as 50 mg/kg, where a cap like "up to" or "not to exceed" is about to be given.

modes.label: Parenthesis after mg/kg
modes.description: An opening bracket directly after a per-kilogram dose, introducing a upper limit.
modes.example: a single dose of 50 mg/kg<< (>>up to 2 g) with food

modes.label: Other cap lead-ins
modes.description: A comma or the word "a" after a per-kilogram dose, leading into "maximum".

card.writes: It promotes words meaning maximum or upper limit, mostly Chinese terms plus "maximum".
card.plain: It fires after a dose per kilogram of body weight, just before a maximum dose is stated.
